tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground, the cool paper behind every panel; also the Dialog and Sheet ground as in the source.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, card, popover, muted, secondary, rail and accent. Passes 4.5:1 on all of them in both themes.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels, ledgers and the ApprovalSheet surface.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. Same value as foreground in the source.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one cobalt accent, for action only: primary Button fill, links, the Budget meter at normal use. Passes 4.5:1 as text on background, card, popover, muted, secondary, rail and info-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. 8.17:1 light, 7.73:1 dark; dark text on the lightened dark-theme accent.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tabs track, meter track, row hover at 50 percent.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps and units on background, card, popover, muted, secondary, rail and the three soft status grounds. Passes 4.5:1 on all in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected ground; the leaf box in a Proof.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive Button and Badge fill, with destructive-foreground text: 6.57:1 light (white on #b42318) and 6.90:1 dark (#0c121b on #f07a6e). Dark fills lighten the accent, so the dark theme uses dark text on a solid fill, as primary does.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a destructive fill. 6.57:1 light, 6.90:1 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative at 1.27:1 and 1.26:1 on card; never the only thing separating meaning.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Boundary of Input, Select, Textarea and the Switch track. Holds 3:1 against every ground it sits on: light 3.26 (accent) to 3.82 (card), dark 3.21 (accent) to 4.12 (background). The dark Input fill is this value at 30 percent.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline, 2px solid with 2px offset. At least 7:1 on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet text a step below muted-foreground: empty values, copy and info icons, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on every ground: light 4.60 (accent) to 5.38 (card), dark 4.60 (accent) to 5.90 (background).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Sidebar and footer strips of panels.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Means settled and nothing else. Text on card, background and positive-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a settled StatusPill and a verified ProofPanel.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Means waiting and nothing else. Text on card, background and warning-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a waiting StatusPill and the risk block in ApprovalSheet.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Means refused and nothing else. Text on card, background and negative-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a refused StatusPill and the RefusalReason icon.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral in-progress ground with primary text.

tokens.name: on-semantic
tokens.usage: Intentional addition naming the source's text-white and dark:text-background on solid positive or negative seals. At least 5.34:1 where it is used.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Intentional addition naming the source's literal bg-black/50 behind Dialog and Sheet.

tokens.name: flow-1
tokens.usage: Flow graph edge 1. Chart mark, not text.

tokens.name: flow-2
tokens.usage: Flow graph edge 2. Chart mark, not text.

tokens.name: flow-3
tokens.usage: Flow graph edge 3. Chart mark, not text.

tokens.name: flow-4
tokens.usage: Flow graph edge 4. Chart mark, not text.

tokens.name: flow-5
tokens.usage: Flow graph edge 5. Chart mark, not text.

tokens.name: flow-node
tokens.usage: Flow graph nodes.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Bars in day charts.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Lines in charts.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axis tick labels. Same values as subtle, so tick text passes 4.5:1 on card and background in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: Chart hover band.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans 400, 500, 600 and 700 with feature ss02 on the body.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: ProofPanel verdict and other result headings.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel headings and the ApprovalSheet title.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every paid Call is checked against this Budget.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Form input text below 768px, so iOS does not zoom on focus.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: This Payee is not on the Budget's list.
styles.usage: Default interface text, table cells and field values.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Equals the root stored on NEAR.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in BatchSummary only.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Labels inside hash boxes. Never below this size.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono 400 and 500 only; no heavier weight is loaded. Numerals are tabular.

styles.name: amount-display
styles.usage: Remaining amount in BudgetMeter and the large amount in ApprovalSheet.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Call IDs, on-chain roots and transaction hashes.

spacing.note: Tailwind 4 steps in use in the dashboard (0.25rem base), plus one mobile minimum.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text gap in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: StatusPill dot gap, label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, pill padding, button groups.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Hash box padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gap, icon to content.

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Panel header vertical padding, CallRow padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, panel padding below 640px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding from 640px, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet page gutter, Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, header margin.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: the minimum touch target on coarse pointers. The source meets it on checkout controls but not on 24px copy buttons.

radius.note: One base value, derived steps resolved from calc() to literals.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base from which the steps are derived.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks and inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Button, Input, Tabs trigger.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog, Tabs track, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, ApprovalSheet, mobile primary actions.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: StatusPill, Badge, meters and seals.

shadow.note: Tailwind 4 defaults as used by the shadcn parts. Panels use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Outline Button and Input.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Active Tabs trigger.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog, Sheet and menus.
